(c)

Issuer purchases of equity securities. 

On December 6, 2011, the Company s Board of Directors
approved a plan to repurchase up to $300 million of the Company s outstanding common stock. As of March 31, 2015, the Company has repurchased 5.7 million shares for $234.7 million under this plan. There were no repurchases made
under this plan during the first three months of 2015.
